elderly_external_validation.reason: No independent elderly longitudinal paired dataset has been supplied.

measured_software_validation.command: python -m pytest tests/mental tests/fusion tests/pipeline tests/ui tests/integration -q; python -m pytest tests/alerts -q

behavior_gate.persistence_rule: same feature in at least 2 of the last 3 effective days

shadow_baseline_reference.claim_boundary: research screening only; not elderly validation or diagnosis

limitations: The EATD baseline is not an elderly clinical or field validation set.
MacBERT/eGeMAPS adapters remain optional research components; missing weights abstain.
No psychological diagnosis, emergency decision, or automatic family/EZVIZ message is produced.
Promotion requires an independent elderly subject-level external evaluation and staffed human review.
